LLM-Assisted Analysis

Soma subsystem integration: boot OK, stage-2 pipe EAGAIN

Provider: deepseek · Model: deepseek-chat · Generated On: 2026-07-04T09:41:42+00:00 · Stage: success · Confidence: high

This PR introduces the Soma subsystem (robonix-soma), a raw body YAML/URDF gRPC service that also owns primitive and skill package bring-up in two stages. The CI boot completed successfully: all 11 components (atlas, executor, soma, pilot, liaison, scene, memory, speech, voiceprint, mapping, nav2) reached ACTIVE state. Soma's stage 1 spawned all 4 primitives (tiago_chassis, tiago_camera, tiago_lidar, audio_driver) and they registered ACTIVE. Stage 2 (skill bring-up) was skipped because the stage-trigger pipe returned EAGAIN (Resource temporarily unavailable), which is a non-fatal warning — primitives and system services are up. The final capability snapshot confirms all expected providers including soma's get_yaml/get_urdf are registered. Pilot successfully loaded Soma body context at startup.

PR Changes

  • Added new `system/soma` crate with gRPC services for get_yaml and get_urdf
  • Added Soma YAML/URDF test fixtures under `examples/test_ci/`
  • Added Webots deployment Soma YAML under `examples/webots/soma.yaml`
  • Added capability contract TOML files for get_yaml and get_urdf
  • Modified `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` to include robonix-soma workspace member
  • Modified `Makefile` with build-soma target and install step
  • Modified `system/atlas/src/service.rs` with minor formatting fix
  • Modified `system/pilot/src/main.rs`, `planner.rs`, `service.rs` to fetch and inject Soma body context into system prompt
  • Added `system/pilot/src/soma_context.rs` for Soma YAML/URDF fetching
  • Modified `tools/rbnx/src/cmd/deploy.rs` with soma spawning, stage-2 pipe, and manifest defaults
  • Modified `tools/rbnx/src/cmd/clean.rs` and `run_package.rs` to include soma in builtins list
  • Added `tools/rbnx/src/launch.rs` with shared package bring-up primitives (wait_for_registration_core, call_driver_cmd)
  • Modified `tools/rbnx/src/lib.rs` and `process.rs` to expose launch module and add process group support
  • Modified `tools/rbnx/Cargo.toml` to add nix 'fs' feature

Test Result

  • Webots CI booted the full stack: atlas, executor, soma, pilot, liaison, scene, memory, speech, voiceprint, mapping, nav2 all reached ACTIVE. Soma stage 1 spawned 4 primitives (tiago_chassis, tiago_camera, tiago_lidar, audio_driver) successfully. Stage 2 (skill bring-up) was skipped due to EAGAIN on the stage-trigger pipe — this is a known non-fatal condition when running without rbnx boot (hand-launch scenario). The final capability snapshot shows all providers including soma's get_yaml/get_urdf. Pilot loaded Soma body context. The boot log shows 11 components up with no failures.

Suggested Fix

  • The EAGAIN on the stage-trigger pipe is expected when soma is launched without rbnx boot (hand-launch). In production via rbnx boot, the pipe is properly inherited and written to. No fix needed; this is a non-issue for the CI scenario.

Risks Or Watchouts

  • Stage-2 skill bring-up is skipped when the stage-trigger pipe returns EAGAIN — this is expected in hand-launch scenarios but operators should verify skills come up when using rbnx boot.
  • The Soma YAML/URDF loading depends on file paths relative to the deployment directory; ensure robot_yaml is correctly set in the manifest or auto-injected.
  • Pilot's Soma context injection is best-effort; if Soma is not available, Pilot continues without body context — this is logged as a warning.
